name: Royal
summary: Pitch-black luxury realtor site where full-bleed dusk property photos stack on scroll, with flat white uppercase grotesk and tiny square white buttons.

fonts.pairing: single grotesk family at weight 500; uppercase for H1 and big H2, sentence case for body and labels

signature: four full-viewport property photos pinned with sticky so each slides over the last, title and address centred on the image
hero headline bottom-left with a small thumbnail strip bottom-right acting as a slideshow index
imagery: moody dusk and night architecture photography, warm window glow against dark sky, dark-suited founder portrait
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 75px section padding, 45px heading-to-content gap, 3-column blog grid, square corners everywhere
